claim_scope: Complete integral homotopy types at all integer stages of the Frucht graph vertex-induced forest filtration, and the split reduced integral homology persistence module.
scientific_integrity: All numerical certificates are from finite complete enumerations of twelve vertices; the homotopy deductions use stated discrete-Morse and Hurewicz results; no independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the stated LCF-defined twelve-vertex graph; no all-cubic or all-Halin theorem, no equivariant homotopy classification, no independent audit, and unindexed earlier work could affect priority. The d=0 independence complex is previously known.
title: Integral homotopy and persistence of the Frucht graph's induced-forest filtration
